summary: Phase 1 follow-up #2 backend retest. 47/47 in-scope tests PASSED (100%) after applying 1 line-level fix. Ran test_phase1_followup.py (15/15), test_phase1_role_reshuffle.py (28/28) regression, and new test_phase1_followup2.py (4/4) covering the additional endpoints in the review request: /po/{id}/grns, /grns, /invoice list, /billing/update as director. All previously-flagged director-access gates now return 200 (POST /po, GET /po/{id}/pdf, GET /billing/items, GET /po/{id}/grns, GET /grns, GET /invoice, GET /invoice/{id}/pdf, POST /billing/update). Regression is green: PM-off-project MRF approve 403, PM-on-project 200, /audit admin-only, /users email redaction (admin sees emails, others empty), /po/{id}/received still 403 for pm/gm and 200 for director/purchase/admin, submit_mrf notifies role='pm'. No lingering 500s on current server; historical 500s in err.log pre-date iteration 9 (older _check_po_access NameError already resolved).

minor.issue: The problem statement claimed this was already fixed in iteration 9, but server.py:1086 still had `('purchase', 'admin', 'purchase')` (duplicated 'purchase', missing director). action_items: Legacy test suites (test_security_hardening.py, test_sec002_pdf_scoping.py, test_mrf_po_workflow.py) are STALE — they call /auth/dev-login with roles 'site_engineer', 'project_manager', 'billing' which were retired in Phase 1 role reshuffle. These are pre-existing failures unrelated to the current review; they should either be updated to use the canonical roles (pm/purchase) or be deleted since the same coverage exists in test_phase1_role_reshuffle.py. Not blocking.

Consider extracting shared role tuples into named constants (e.g. ALLOW_PURCHASE_AND_APPROVERS = ('purchase', 'director', 'admin')) to prevent recurrence of the duplicated-role-tuple bug class that has appeared in 3 consecutive iterations. Recommended for main agent Phase 1 cleanup pass 3.

Dead-code duplicate `if u.role == 'pm':` blocks remain at server.py 405/412, 715/717, 729/738, 748/752 (legacy site_engineer->pm rename artefacts). The second block in each pair is unreachable. Safe to remove but purely cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: Line 1086 role-gate fix (`('purchase', 'admin', 'purchase')` -> `('purchase', 'admin', 'director')`) was explicitly listed as done in the problem statement but was in fact still present. Recommend the main agent add a grep-verification step to the PR checklist: `grep -nE "'purchase',\s*'purchase'|'pm',\s*'pm'" backend/server.py` should return zero results.
The unused role-tuple duplicates are all in server.py; no other file has the pattern. A single file-scoped constant would eliminate the bug class entirely.
